description: Boot a device to an agent-ready state; from its baseline snapshot this takes seconds and returns state booted. The first boot of a new Android device (or a baseline retake after a GPU mode, AVD configuration or agemu upgrade) prepares the baseline once, which usually takes 7-8 minutes and never more than 20 (then the boot fails): boot then returns at once with state "preparing" and the phase; poll devices every 30-60 s (or call boot again) until the state is booted. Other calls on a preparing device fail at once with an error saying so.

device.description: Device id or name (optional when exactly one device is booted)

name: boot
